output.description: Frame size, rate, duration and encoding settings of the output.

outputs.description:
Further files rendered from the same composition in one pass:
video renditions, a poster, a sprite sheet, audio. Keys name them;
each is written under the directory `render -o` names. With
outputs present, `output` describes the canvas the outputs are
made from.

assets.description:
Media files the composition may reference, keyed by a short id.
Layers refer to assets by id and never by path.

compositions.description:
Reusable sub-compositions, keyed by name. A clip shows one with a
source of kind "composition".

keyframes.description:
Named motion, spelled like CSS `@keyframes`: each rule maps an
offset ("from", "to", "60%") to a declaration block
("transform: translateX(-656px); opacity: 0"). A clip plays one
with its `animation` field.

layers.description: Visual layers, composited from first (bottom) to last (top).

audio.description: Audio-only tracks, mixed together with the audio of video clips.

subtitles.description: Subtitle tracks written to the output as text streams.

title: Geneva timeline
description: Geneva timeline format 1.1: a declarative video composition.

duration.description: Total duration. Defaults to the end of the last clip.

background.description:
Color the frame is cleared to before compositing. Defaults to opaque
black; use "transparent" for outputs with alpha.

color.description:
Color tags written to the output. Defaults to BT.709 SDR, limited
range.

encode.description: Encoder settings. Defaults are chosen per container.

WholePixels.title: WholePixels
WholePixels.description: A size in whole pixels, as a number (1920) or a string ("1920px").

Fps.title: Fps
Fps.description: Frames per second: a positive number (30, 29.97) or an exact ratio string ("30000/1001").

Time.title: Time
Time.description: A time or duration: seconds as a number, or a string with a unit ("1.5s", "500ms", "45f" for frames at the output rate) or a timecode ("00:01:02.5").

Color.title: Color
Color.description: An sRGB color: "#rgb", "#rrggbb", "#rrggbbaa", "rgb(r, g, b)", "rgba(r, g, b, a)" or a basic name (black, white, red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, magenta, gray, orange, transparent).

ColorTags.description:
Color metadata as reported by a decoder or written in a timeline.

Each field is optional: `None` means "not tagged", which is exactly the
situation [`crate::infer`] resolves.

oneOf.description: ITU-R BT.709, shared by sRGB. The default for HD material.
ITU-R BT.601 as used with 625-line systems (BT.470 B/G, PAL).
ITU-R BT.601 as used with 525-line systems (SMPTE 170M, NTSC).
ITU-R BT.2020, used by HDR and wide-gamut UHD material.

Primaries.description: Chromaticity of the red, green and blue primaries and the white point.

oneOf.description:
The piecewise sRGB curve (IEC 61966-2-1). The default for still images
and graphics.

The ITU-R BT.709 curve, shared by BT.601 and BT.2020 SDR. The default
for SDR video.
Linear light; samples are proportional to radiance.

Transfer.description: The opto-electronic transfer characteristic of encoded samples.

oneOf.description: ITU-R BT.709 coefficients. The default for HD material.
ITU-R BT.601 coefficients. The default for SD material.

Matrix.description: The matrix used to derive Y'CbCr from R'G'B'.

oneOf.description: Y' in 16..=235 and Cb/Cr in 16..=240 at 8 bits, scaled with bit depth.
All codes from 0 to the maximum are used.

Range.description: Whether coded samples use the full code range or the video (limited) range.

sample_rate.description: Sample rate in Hz. Defaults to 48000.

loudness.description:
A loudness to bring the mix to. Unset, the mix is written at
whatever level its sources add up to.

hygiene.description:
Audio hygiene for speech: a high-pass at 80 Hz that takes rumble,
handling noise and DC offset, and notches on mains hum (50 or 60
Hz and its harmonics) where the mix has some. Fixed curves. On
music the high-pass takes the bass under 80 Hz with it. Defaults
to false.

target_lufs.description: Integrated loudness to aim for, in LUFS: -40 to -5.

true_peak_dbtp.description: Ceiling for the true peak in dBTP, -20 to 0. Defaults to -1.

Loudness.description:
A loudness target for the mix, measured as ITU-R BS.1770-4 (EBU R128)
measures it: K-weighted, gated, over the whole output. The mix is
read once to measure it, then written with one gain, and a limiter
holds the true peak under its ceiling. Platforms normalise to -14
LUFS (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram) or ask for -16 (podcasts);
broadcast asks for -23 (EBU) or -24 (ATSC).

container.description: Container format. Defaults to the extension of the output path.

fast_start.description:
Whether MP4, MOV and M4A files carry their index at the front, so
playback can start before the download ends. Defaults to true.

Encode.description: Encoder settings for the rendered file.

oneOf.description: MXF (Material Exchange Format), for broadcast delivery.

One image file per frame. The output path is a pattern such as
`frames/%04d.png`; the extension picks PNG or JPEG.

codec.description: Codec. Defaults to h264 for mp4/mov/mkv and vp9 for webm.

crf.description:
Constant-quality level; lower is better quality and larger files.
The useful range is roughly 18 to 30 for h264 and h265.

preset.description: Encoder speed/efficiency preset, for example "medium" or "slow".

profile.description:
Codec profile, for prores and dnxhd. Defaults to "hq" for prores
and "dnxhr-hq" for dnxhd.

keyframe_interval.description:
Seconds between keyframes. Defaults to the encoder's own choice;
2 is the usual value for anything played over a network.

max_bitrate_kbps.description:
Bitrate ceiling in kb/s. Quality stays constant until the ceiling
bites, as a player's buffer or a platform's limit requires.

bitrate_kbps.description:
Average bitrate in kb/s to aim for. Encoders that hold constant
quality under a ceiling (x264) ignore it; hardware encoders, which
cannot, switch to their bitrate mode at this rate.

level.description:
H.264 or H.265 level, for example "4.1", which tells old decoders
what the stream needs. Defaults to what the encoder picks.

tune.description:
What the picture is like, so the encoder spends its bits
accordingly, in x264's names. Encoders without an equivalent
ignore it and the report says so.

fixed_keyframes.description:
Place keyframes at the interval only, never at scene changes, as
streaming platforms and segmenters want. Needs `keyframe_interval`.

chunks.description:
How many stretches the output is encoded in at once, each on its
own cores, joined afterwards: `"auto"` (the default) decides from
the encoder and the machine, a number forces it, `1` turns it off.

oneOf.description: Avid DNxHD / DNxHR, 8-bit or 10-bit 4:2:2 by profile.

Use a hardware encoder when one is available and works, otherwise
fall back to software.
Fail if no hardware encoder is available.

HardwarePolicy.description: Whether to use a hardware encoder.

oneOf.description: Animation: flat areas and sharp edges.
Grainy material: keeps the grain instead of smoothing it.
Cheaper to decode, for weak players.
No lookahead or frame delay, for live use.

VideoTune.description: What the picture is like, in x264's tune names.

anyOf.description: Decided from the encoder's scaling and the machine's cores.
This many; `1` encodes in one run.

Chunks.description: How many stretches to encode at once.

codec.description: Codec. Defaults to aac for mp4/mov/mkv and opus for webm.

bitrate_kbps.description: Bitrate in kilobits per second. Defaults to 160.

path.description:
File name, relative to the output directory. Defaults to the
output's name with the kind's usual extension (`.mp4`, `.jpg`,
`.wav`); a sprite sheet writes a `.vtt` map next to it.

width.description:
Picture width. For a video rendition or a poster, the canvas is
scaled to it; giving one of width and height keeps the aspect.

height.description:
Picture height. For a sprite sheet, the height of one tile
(default 90).

encode.description:
Encoder settings for a video or audio output; a video rendition
falls back to `output.encode`.

audio.description:
Audio format for a video or audio output; falls back to
`output.audio`.

at.description:
Poster: the time of the frame to take. Without it the frame is
chosen: the first clear, non-black frame after the opening.

every.description:
Sprite sheet: the interval between tiles. Without it the sheet
holds about a hundred tiles, at least a second apart.

OutputSpec.description: One file of a multi-output render, made from the composition.

oneOf.description: A video file: the composition, scaled to the entry's size.
A tiled sheet of small frames with a WebVTT map, for scrubbing.
An audio file of the mix.

src.description:
Path relative to the asset root. Absolute paths and ".." segments
are not allowed.

kind.description: What the file contains. Inferred from the extension when omitted.

color.description: Color tags that override or complete what the file declares.

Asset.description: A media file referenced by the composition.

oneOf.description: A video file, possibly with audio.

A caption file a clip draws: SubRip, WebVTT, or the JSON a
speech recogniser writes, one entry per word.
A markup file drawn by the HTML source.

AssetKind.description: The kind of content in an asset.

layers.description: Visual layers, composited from first (bottom) to last (top).

CompositionDef.description:
A reusable composition: its own frame, its own layers, rendered as a
unit and placed like an image. Times inside it are relative to the
clip that shows it, and percentages refer to its own size.

enabled.description: Set to false to skip the layer without removing it.

clips.description:
Clips in time order. A clip without "start" begins where the
previous clip ends.

Layer.description: A visual layer: a sequence of non-overlapping clips.

start.description:
When the clip begins on the timeline. Defaults to the end of the
previous clip in the layer, or 0 for the first clip.

duration.description:
How long the clip lasts. Defaults to the source range for video and
audio, and to the end of the output for images, solids, shapes and
text.

transition.description:
How the clip arrives. With a clip before it on the layer, this one
starts early by the transition duration and the pair blends. As the
first clip on a layer it opens the piece: a "fade" comes up out of
its color, a "crossfade" up from whatever is behind.

transition_out.description:
How the clip leaves, when nothing follows it on the layer. A "fade"
goes out to its color, a "crossfade" out to whatever is behind.
Where another clip follows, that clip's "transition" already covers
the join and setting this too is an E307.

crop.description:
A rectangle of the source to show; the rest is discarded before
"fit" and the transform see the picture, so the clip's box is the
rectangle. Percentages refer to the source's own size.

fit.description:
How the source is sized to the output frame before the transform.
Defaults to "contain" for video and to "none" (natural size) for
everything else.

animation.description:
Motion from the document's `keyframes`, spelled like the CSS
`animation` shorthand: a rule name with a duration, and optionally
a delay, a timing function, an iteration count and a direction
("slide-in 0.5s ease-out", "pulse 2s infinite alternate").
Several are separated by commas. What a rule sets is applied on
top of `transform` and replaces `opacity`.

blend.description: Blend mode against the layers below. Defaults to "normal".

effects.description:
Effects applied to the placed picture, in order, before opacity
and blending.

mask.description:
A mask limiting what the clip shows: a shape cut from the clip's
box, or the luma of an image stretched over it. It moves and
scales with the clip.

speed.description:
How fast the source plays: 2 is twice as fast, 0.5 half speed.
The clip lasts its source range divided by this; the source's
audio is resampled, so its pitch follows. The clip's own keyframes
stay in output time. Defaults to 1.

Clip.description: A clip: a source placed on the timeline with a transform and opacity.

asset.description: Id of an asset of kind "video".

in.description: Where in the source to start. Defaults to 0.

out.description: Where in the source to stop. Defaults to the end of the file.

audio.description:
Whether the asset's audio is mixed into the output. Defaults to
true.

oneOf.description: Frames (and optionally audio) from a video asset.

asset.description: Id of an asset of kind "image".

oneOf.description: A frame-sized rectangle of one color.

stroke.description: Outline drawn inside the box edge.

radius.description: Corner radius for rectangles, in pixels.

text.description:
The text to show. Required unless "words" is given, in which case it
defaults to the words joined by spaces.

words.description:
Timed words for caption-style highlighting. Times are relative to the
clip start.

highlight.description:
Style applied to the word whose time range contains the current
time.

font.description:
Font: the id of an asset of kind "font", a family name available
on the system, or the CSS `font` shorthand ("600 40px/1.2 Inter"),
whose parts fill in size, weight, italic and line_height unless
those are set.

size.description: Font size in pixels. Defaults to 48.

color.description: Text color. Defaults to white. Takes keyframes.

fill.description:
A gradient that fills the glyphs in place of `color`: an object,
or the gradient string alone.

letter_spacing.description: Extra spacing between letters in pixels.

max_width.description: Maximum line width before wrapping. Defaults to the output width.

align.description: Horizontal alignment within the box. Defaults to "center".

line_height.description: Line height as a multiple of the font size. Defaults to 1.2.

padding.description: Padding between the text and its background box, in pixels.

background.description: Background box color. Defaults to none.

radius.description: Background box corner radius in pixels.

shadow.description: Drop shadows: one, or a list front to back.

oneOf.description: Styled text, optionally with per-word timing.

asset.description: Id of an asset of kind "html", read as the markup.

css.description: A stylesheet applied after any `<style>` in the markup.

width.description:
Box width: a length, or "auto" to fit the content. Defaults to
the frame width, so markup is laid out on a surface the size of
the picture, the way a page is.

height.description:
Box height: a length, or "auto" to fit the content, which is
how a card sizes itself to its text. Defaults to the frame
height.

oneOf.description:
A box of markup: HTML and CSS laid out with flexbox and drawn.

The markup comes from `html` or from an asset of kind "html", and
the styles from a `<style>` element inside it, from `css`, or
both. There is no inline layout: an element's text is one
paragraph and a child element is a box of its own.

asset.description: Id of an asset of kind "captions".

in.description:
Where in the file to start. Cues that end before it are left
out and the rest move earlier by it, so a captions clip with
the `in` of the video clip it captions stays in step with it.
Defaults to 0.

out.description:
Where in the file to stop. Cues from it on are left out and one
running past it is cut there. Defaults to the end of the file.

position.description: Where cues sit. Defaults to the bottom.

margin.description: Distance from the edge. Defaults to the title-safe inset.

safe.description:
Title-safe inset as a percentage of the frame height: the
default margin, and a margin inside it is a note. Defaults to
5; 0 turns the note off.

follow_file.description:
Whether a WebVTT file's own placement wins over the fields
above. Defaults to true; set false to place every cue the
same way whatever the file says.

max_lines.description: Most lines a cue shows at once. Defaults to 2.

max_chars.description:
Most characters on one of those lines. Defaults to 42, the
broadcast convention. Grouping counts characters because it
runs before `style` and has no font to measure with, so this
and `max_lines` are together the whole of the budget; see the
timeline reference for setting it against a `style.max_width`.

min_duration.description:
Shortest a cue may be, so that a word lasting a fifth of a
second is still readable. Defaults to 1.2s.

merge_gap.description:
A gap no longer than this between cues is closed rather than
blinking the caption off and on. Defaults to 0.1s.

style.description:
How the captions look: the same fields a text source takes,
minus the ones that say what the text is.

oneOf.description:
Captions from a file: SubRip, WebVTT, or the JSON a speech
recogniser writes.

The resolver turns the file into one clip per cue, so a caption
track costs only the frames it is on, and takes its times from
the file rather than from `start` and `duration`. Where it sits
comes from `position` and `margin`, inside the title-safe area by
default; a WebVTT cue that asks for somewhere else is obeyed
unless the document overrides it.

Source.description: What a clip shows, selected by "kind".

Animated_Color.description: Either a constant value or {"keyframes": [...]} with values interpolated over time.

Keyframe_Color.description: One keyframe: {"t": .., "v": .., "ease": ..} or the same three in order as [t, v] or [t, v, ease].

cubic-bezier.description: Control points; `x1` and `x2` must lie in `[0, 1]`.

anyOf.description: A cubic bezier with control points `[x1, y1, x2, y2]`, as in CSS.
A damped spring, rescaled to settle at the end of the segment.

steps.description: How many steps, and where the jumps fall.

anyOf.description: A staircase of equal steps, as CSS `steps(n, position)`.

Straight lines through points, as CSS `linear()`: each point is
`[input, output]`, inputs from 0 to 1 in order.

Easing.description:
An easing curve applied to the segment that starts at a keyframe.

In JSON an easing is either a preset name (`"ease-out"`), an object with
a `cubic-bezier` array, a `spring` block, a `steps` pair or a `linear`
list of points.

oneOf.description: Holds the starting value for the whole segment, then jumps.

stiffness.description: Spring constant. Higher values make a snappier motion.

damping.description: Damping coefficient. Lower values bounce more.

mass.description: Attached mass. Higher values make a slower, heavier motion.

Spring.description:
Parameters of a damped spring.

The spring is solved analytically and rescaled so that it settles exactly
at the end of the keyframe segment; the parameters control the shape of
the motion (overshoot and bounce), not its duration.

oneOf.description:
The first jump is at the start, so the segment never shows its
starting value.

The last jump is at the end, so the segment never shows its final
value until then. CSS's default.
Both ends are held: `n` steps make `n - 1` jumps.
Neither end is held: `n` steps make `n + 1` jumps.

StepPosition.description: Where a staircase jumps: the second argument of CSS `steps()`.

oneOf.description: An axis-aligned rectangle filling the box.
An ellipse inscribed in the box.

Length.title: Length
Length.description: Pixels as a number (120) or a string with a unit ("120px", "50%"). Percentages refer to the output width for x values and the output height for y values.

Stroke.title: Stroke
Stroke.description: An outline: an object with width and color, or the shorthand "<width> <color>" such as "2px black".

anyOf.description: The object form of an outline.

Pixels.title: Pixels
Pixels.description: Pixels as a number (8) or a string ("8px").

Word.title: Word
Word.description: One timed word: {"text": .., "start": .., "end": ..} or the same three in order as [text, start] or [text, start, end]. Without an end, a word runs to the next word's start; the last word needs its own.

font.description:
Font: the id of an asset of kind "font", a family name available
on the system, or the CSS `font` shorthand ("600 40px/1.2 Inter"),
whose parts fill in size, weight, italic and line_height unless
those are set.

size.description: Font size in pixels. Defaults to 48.

color.description: Text color. Defaults to white. Takes keyframes.

fill.description:
A gradient that fills the glyphs in place of `color`: an object,
or the gradient string alone.

letter_spacing.description: Extra spacing between letters in pixels.

TextStyle.description: Font and color properties of text.

TextFill.title: TextFill
TextFill.description: A gradient that fills the glyphs: an object with gradient, width, height, x and y, or the gradient string alone, such as "linear-gradient(90deg, #7A51CF, #C28072)".

anyOf.description: The object form of a text fill.

gradient.description: The colour or gradient, in CSS.

width.description: The tile's width in pixels. Defaults to the text's own width.

height.description: The tile's height in pixels. Defaults to the text's own height.

x.description:
Where the tile starts, in pixels from the left of the text's box.
Takes keyframes.

y.description:
Where the tile starts, in pixels from the top of the text's box.
Takes keyframes.

Animated_Pixels.description: Either a constant value or {"keyframes": [...]} with values interpolated over time.

Keyframe_Pixels.description: One keyframe: {"t": .., "v": .., "ease": ..} or the same three in order as [t, v] or [t, v, ease].

Shadows.title: Shadows
Shadows.description: One shadow, or a list of them front to back, each an object or a text-shadow string; a string may itself list several with commas.

Shadow.title: Shadow
Shadow.description: A drop shadow: an object with x, y, blur and color, or the text-shadow shorthand "<x> <y> [blur] [color]" such as "0 2px 8px #0008".

anyOf.description: The object form of a shadow.

color.description: Shadow color. Defaults to 50% black. Takes keyframes.

x.description: Horizontal offset in pixels. Takes keyframes.

y.description: Vertical offset in pixels. Takes keyframes.

blur.description: Blur radius in pixels. Takes keyframes.

BoxSize.title: BoxSize
BoxSize.description: A box dimension: a length (a number of pixels, "120px", or a percentage of the frame), or "auto" to fit the content.

oneOf.description: Along the bottom, the usual place.
Along the top, for when the lower third is busy.
In the middle of the frame.

CaptionPosition.description: Where captions sit in the frame.

text.description:
The text to show. Required unless "words" is given, in which case it
defaults to the words joined by spaces.

words.description:
Timed words for caption-style highlighting. Times are relative to the
clip start.

highlight.description:
Style applied to the word whose time range contains the current
time.

font.description:
Font: the id of an asset of kind "font", a family name available
on the system, or the CSS `font` shorthand ("600 40px/1.2 Inter"),
whose parts fill in size, weight, italic and line_height unless
those are set.

size.description: Font size in pixels. Defaults to 48.

color.description: Text color. Defaults to white. Takes keyframes.

fill.description:
A gradient that fills the glyphs in place of `color`: an object,
or the gradient string alone.

letter_spacing.description: Extra spacing between letters in pixels.

max_width.description: Maximum line width before wrapping. Defaults to the output width.

align.description: Horizontal alignment within the box. Defaults to "center".

line_height.description: Line height as a multiple of the font size. Defaults to 1.2.

padding.description: Padding between the text and its background box, in pixels.

background.description: Background box color. Defaults to none.

radius.description: Background box corner radius in pixels.

shadow.description: Drop shadows: one, or a list front to back.

duration.description:
How long it lasts: the overlap between a pair of clips, or the
ramp at the head or tail of a layer.

color.description:
The color a "fade" passes through. Defaults to black. Ignored by
"crossfade", which never shows a color of its own (W304).

ease.description:
Shape of the ramp. Defaults to linear; "ease-in-out" is the usual
choice for a slow dissolve.

oneOf.description:
Fade the incoming clip in over the outgoing one. Both are visible
at once, and the sound crosses at constant power.

Dip through a color: the outgoing clip fades to it over the first
half of the overlap, the incoming clip out of it over the second.
Only one is ever visible, and the sound goes to silence and back.

width.description: Width. Defaults to the rest of the source to the right of "x".

height.description: Height. Defaults to the rest of the source below "y".

Crop.description:
A rectangle of a source, in source pixels or in percentages of the
source's own width and height.

oneOf.description: Natural size, one source pixel per output pixel.
Scale uniformly so the whole source fits inside the frame.
Scale uniformly so the source covers the whole frame, cropping edges.
Stretch to the frame, ignoring aspect ratio.

Fit.description: How a source is sized to the output frame.

position.description:
Where the anchor lands in the output frame. Defaults to the frame
center ("50%", "50%").

anchor.description:
The point of the clip's box that is placed at "position".
Percentages refer to the box size. Defaults to the box center.

scale.description: Scale factor around the anchor. Defaults to 1.

rotation.description: Rotation around the anchor in degrees, clockwise. Defaults to 0.

Transform.description:
Position, anchor, scale and rotation of a clip.

The anchor is a point on the clip's own box, expressed as a percentage of
the box or in pixels of the box. It is placed at "position" in the output
frame; scale and rotation are applied around it.

Animated_Point.description: Either a constant value or {"keyframes": [...]} with values interpolated over time.

Point.title: Point
Point.description: A 2D point: {"x": .., "y": ..}, a pair like [30, 36], or a string of one or two components ("30 36", "0% 50%", "left", "bottom right"). A component is a length or one of left, right, top, bottom, center.

Keyframe_Point.description: One keyframe: {"t": .., "v": .., "ease": ..} or the same three in order as [t, v] or [t, v, ease].

Animated_Scale.description: Either a constant value or {"keyframes": [...]} with values interpolated over time.

Scale.title: Scale
Scale.description: A uniform scale factor (1.5) or separate factors per axis ({"x": 1, "y": 2}). 1 is natural size.

Keyframe_Scale.description: One keyframe: {"t": .., "v": .., "ease": ..} or the same three in order as [t, v] or [t, v, ease].

Animated_double.description: Either a constant value or {"keyframes": [...]} with values interpolated over time.

Keyframe_double.description: One keyframe: {"t": .., "v": .., "ease": ..} or the same three in order as [t, v] or [t, v, ease].

oneOf.description: Darkens: the product of the two colors.
Lightens: the inverse product of the inverted colors.
Multiplies dark areas and screens light ones, increasing contrast.
Keeps the darker of the two colors per channel.
Keeps the lighter of the two colors per channel.
The absolute difference of the two colors.
Adds the two colors; bright areas can clip.

BlendMode.description: Blend modes, computed in linear light.

radius.description:
The blur's standard deviation in output pixels (as CSS's
`blur()`); 0 leaves the picture as it is. Animatable.

Effect.description:
An effect on a clip's picture, selected by "kind". Effects act on the
picture as placed in the output frame, so their sizes are in output
pixels.

x.description: Left edge of the shape's box. Defaults to 0.

y.description: Top edge of the shape's box. Defaults to 0.

width.description: Width of the shape's box. Defaults to the clip's box.

height.description: Height of the shape's box. Defaults to the clip's box.

radius.description: Corner radius of a rectangle, in pixels of the clip's box.

feather.description:
Width of the soft edge in pixels of the clip's box; 0 (the
default) is a hard edge.

asset.description:
Id of an image asset whose luma, times its alpha, is the
coverage: white shows, black hides. Stretched over the clip's box.

invert.description: Whether to show what the mask hides and hide what it shows.

Mask.description:
A mask on a clip, in the coordinates of the clip's box (after the
crop, before the fit and the transform): pixels of the box, or
percentages of its size.

enabled.description: Set to false to mute the track without removing it.

clips.description:
Clips in time order. A clip without "start" begins where the
previous clip ends.

asset.description: Id of an asset of kind "audio" or "video".

in.description: Where in the source to start. Defaults to 0.

out.description: Where in the source to stop. Defaults to the end of the file.

start.description: When the clip begins on the timeline.

duration.description: How long the clip lasts. Defaults to the source range.

speed.description:
How fast the source plays: 2 is twice as fast, 0.5 half speed.
The clip lasts its source range divided by this, and the pitch
follows. Defaults to 1.

AudioClip.description: A clip on an audio track.

enabled.description: Set to false to leave the track out without removing it.

language.description: Language as a BCP 47 or ISO 639 code, for example "en" or "pt-BR".

title.description: Track title shown by players, for example "English (CC)".

offset.description:
Shifts every cue by this much on the output timeline. Defaults to
0; negative values move cues earlier.

SubtitleTrack.description:
A subtitle track: one subtitle file written to the output as a text
stream, for players to show or hide.
